title: MSK Institute Social Media & Community Trust Registry

channels.description: List of official social media channels for MSK Institute

id.description: Unique identifier: youtube, instagram, linkedin, whatsapp, github, facebook, telegram, twitter

name.description: Display name of the platform (e.g., YouTube, Instagram, LinkedIn)

url.description: Full URL to the official profile

badge.description: Short badge tag (e.g., Video Classes, Campus Life, Alumni & Jobs)

followers.description: Follower count or content stat (e.g., 100+ Lessons, Daily Updates, Network)

description.description: Purpose and description shown on trust cards

enabled.description: Set to true to show this channel across the website, or false to hide it

mapsUrl.description: Google Maps link to read/write reviews

phone.description: Formatted phone number with country code (e.g. '+91 83930 42166')

cleanNumber.description: Digits only without spaces or plus symbol (e.g. '918393042166')

defaultMessage.description: Default pre-filled message when user clicks WhatsApp link

counselorName.description: Name of the academic counselor / mentor
